title2: On the corridor that connects Mexico with North America.
description1: True Ciénega Industrial Park fronts the Monterrey - Nuevo Laredo Highway (Highway 85), the main overland freight route between Mexico and the United States, with immediate highway access and a fast connection to the Colombia Highway and the Monterrey Periférico (ring road)
description2: From here, your operation connects to Monterrey International Airport, Interpuerto Monterrey, the Colombia Bridge and the Laredo border crossing —the busiest trade gateway between Mexico and the United States.
description3: And there's an advantage few locations offer: every northbound route —Interpuerto, Colombia, Laredo— starts on the same highway that runs in front of the park. Your trailers don't cross the city; they head straight to the corridor.
